admission.justification: A body that carries decision numbers, local paths or review records is unreadable to the person it is written for; that is the failure this standard exists to prevent, and it cannot be caught after publication because the reader simply stops reading.

applicability: Every visible text this repository publishes: issue titles and bodies, comments, pull request titles and bodies.
conditions: The resolved memory layer carries system/task-publication.md at its root.
exclusions: The hidden markers, the private plan and the receipts, which no reader sees.
Product documentation and the repository's own prose outside a published text.

evidence: 39 written bodies and titles pass the marker/link/prose/secret scans; no public body uses a prohibited abbreviation, path or record.

statement: Every published body is written prose for a reader outside the machine: no decision or task numbers, master or sprint codes, local paths, checksums, agent IDs, review records, version history or provenance tables; requirement IDs are the only abbreviation.
